requirements.general_text: Any of these: A-Level: A pass in A-Level with a minimum of Grade D in any 2 subjects. STPM: A pass in STPM with at least a Grade C (GP 2.00) in any 2 subjects. STAM: A pass in STAM with at least grade Jayyid. Matriculation or Foundation: Matriculation or Foundation with at least a CGPA of 2.00. Diploma (Diploma Level): A Diploma (Level 4, MQF) with at least a CGPA of 2.00. Advanced Diploma (Diploma Level): An Advanced Diploma (Level 5, MQF) with at least a CGPA of 2.00. DKM/DVM (Diploma Level): A Diploma Kemahiran Malaysia (DKM)/Diploma Vokasional Malaysia (DVM) is subjected to the University's approval. DLKM (Diploma Level): A Diploma Lanjutan Kemahiran Malaysia (DLKM) is subjected to the University's approval. Other equivalent qualifications (Other): Other relevant equivalent qualifications recognised by the Malaysian Government, acceptable to the University. English Proficiency (For International Students): Achieve a minimum score of Band 3 in MUET or equivalent to CEFR Low B2. Additional Requirement: Pass an interview (online/virtual/conventional) OR submit a student’s portfolio, to be determined by the University as required.
